reason: Second scaffold-check red root cause on PR #100 (reproduced in Docker python:3.11): test_launch_companion_uses_platform_specific_spawn_options[nt] patches os.name='nt' globally, and launch_companion -> safe_factory_write_bytes -> Path('x.md') then dispatches pathlib.WindowsPath, which Python 3.11 REFUSES to instantiate on POSIX (3.13, used locally, allows it — why macOS was green). The failure then INTERNALERRORs the whole session because the repr also constructs Path under the patched os.name. Test-only fix: stub the brief write so no bare Path() construction runs under the fake os.name.
